This plot is for beans, and beans do not need much chemical fertilizer because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil. I will use some manure from the animals at home to help the soil, but I will not spend money on urea or NPK for this plot — I would rather save that for my cereal plots. For beans in our area, the biggest problem is insects in the pods, so I must spray pesticide, otherwise the harvest will be small. I will plant the local variety seed I saved from last year, and I will do most of the work with my family, only hiring a few people during weeding and harvest.
